## Activity

During April 2023, Oakridge Primary Care recorded 76 captures. This provides the activity position for the month and reflects the work completed through the site’s planned session lists. Session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave. There were no reported changes to the site arrangement in the information provided for this report.

## Image quality

Of the 76 captures, 1 was marked ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 1.3. The result indicates that most captures were available for grading, while a small proportion could not be assessed. The ungradable result is retained in the monthly activity position and should be considered when reviewing overall service performance.

## Grading

Grading identified 14 referable results. The median lag was 1. This records the midpoint of the time taken for grading during April 2023. Taken together, the activity, image quality and grading figures provide the site’s monthly operational summary for Oakridge Primary Care. The information should be read alongside routine local monitoring and any follow-up arrangements associated with referable results.
